OCRelay 1.1.18

THE REVIEW PANEL STAYS ON YOUR MONITOR

• With more than one monitor — especially a portrait monitor beside landscape ones — the review panel could open partly on the neighbouring screen. It now opens on the monitor OCRelay is on, centred there.

• If the panel is too wide for that monitor, the worksheet picture shrinks to make room. The values are never cut off.

• If you move the panel yourself, it stays where you put it.

• The full-size worksheet picture (click the image to zoom) now opens on the same monitor too.
